description: Place a real outbound call only to a user-authorized destination. Requires confirm=true and a stable idempotency_key. This is not a sandbox simulation. Preserve the returned ID; never redial after an uncertain timeout.

agent_id.description: Omni agent that handles the connected call.

agent_release_id.description: Client release identifier pinned to this call; requires client_reference.

client_reference.description: Stable client call identity; requires agent_release_id.

from_number_id.description: Active managed-number ID to present as caller ID.

max_duration_seconds.description: Carrier-enforced maximum duration for integration calls.

stop_requested.description: Recover or cancel the same intent without dialing an unstarted call. Requires client_reference. Excluded from the creation fingerprint.

to.description: Supported E.164 destination: North America (+1), India (+91), or Australian geographic/mobile numbers (+61, without the domestic trunk zero). Country policy, destination consent and caller identity remain required. Australian number purchasing is not available; an existing owned source number can be connected separately.

use_case.description: Declared calling purpose. Determines consent, identity, CNAM, and policy gates.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user authorizes this exact purchase or destination.

idempotency_key.description: Required safe-retry key. Identical retries return the original call; a different body returns 409.
